name: Hyouhen ☆ Namahame Iincho!
original_name: 豹変☆ナマハメいいんちょ！
source:
Main heroine dreams of going to the same school as Shin-kun. On a small study session her glasses go off, and she becomes a fierce S. There are so many new opportunities with this change of personality!

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/07/vn-of-month-february-2008-switch-boku.html]vndbreview[/url]]
